page.overview:
Who is Rick Sternbach?

Doctor Rick Sternbach was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He was a scientific and research specialist.

In 2353, he was listed as a Starfleet Operational Support Services officer on a directory placard for Starbase 32, Maxia Zeta. His office was located in room #45246. (, directory)

In 2364, Captain Sternbach was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, he received an order about modifying the ship's Romulan Neutral Zone border patrol from Commodore Joshua Jae of Starfleet Mission Operations Division. (, okudagram)

In 2368, he was listed as a Advanced Technologies Group officer on the second version of the dedication plaque for the . (, )
